tags.name: Agreements, Subrecipients & Consultants
tags.definition: Agreements and administrative requirements for subrecipient, consultant, and other sponsored-project relationships.

tags.name: Anesthesia, Surgery & Pain Management
tags.definition: Anesthesia, surgical procedures, analgesia, pain recognition, and related animal welfare requirements.

tags.name: Animal & Laboratory Research Materials
tags.definition: Acquiring and handling materials or pharmaceutical agents used in animal or laboratory research.

tags.name: Animal Health, Welfare & Humane Endpoints
tags.definition: Monitoring animal health and well-being, minimizing distress, and applying humane endpoints or euthanasia standards.

tags.name: Animal Housing & Facilities
tags.definition: Animal housing conditions, space allocations, environmental conditions, and specialized research animal facilities.

tags.name: Animal Husbandry & Routine Care
tags.definition: Day-to-day animal care, monitoring, identification, transport, enrichment, and routine husbandry practices.

tags.name: Animal Procedures & Research Agents
tags.definition: Animal research procedures and the preparation or administration of agents used in animal studies.

tags.name: Animal Research Media & Imaging
tags.definition: Creating, using, or handling images, recordings, audio, and video involving research animals.

tags.name: Animal Welfare Reporting & Noncompliance
tags.definition: Reporting, reviewing, and responding to animal welfare concerns, adverse outcomes, or noncompliance.

tags.name: Audit Compliance
tags.definition: Audit obligations, responses, documentation, and compliance for sponsored research activities.

tags.name: Award Acceptance & Setup
tags.definition: Acceptance, authorization, and initial administrative setup of sponsored awards.

tags.name: Award Management
tags.definition: Administrative management of sponsored awards during the award period, including changes and compliance obligations.

tags.name: Award Management & Prior Approvals
tags.definition: Sponsor or institutional approvals required for specified award changes, actions, or expenditures.

tags.name: Budgeting & Cost Planning
tags.definition: Sponsored-project budget development, estimates, cost planning, and budget-related requirements.

tags.name: Cash Advances & Payment Cards
tags.definition: Requirements for cash advances, payment cards, and authorized payment methods for research activities.

tags.name: Clinical Billing & Financial Administration
tags.definition: Clinical research billing, coverage analysis, charges, and related financial administration.

tags.name: Clinical Data, Records & Systems
tags.definition: Systems and procedures for maintaining clinical research administrative data, documents, and electronic records.

tags.name: Clinical Research Electronic Signatures
tags.definition: Requirements for valid electronic signatures on essential clinical research documents.

tags.name: Clinical Study Startup & Oversight
tags.definition: Institutional approvals and operational prerequisites for initiating and overseeing clinical research projects.

tags.name: Clinical Task Delegation & Qualifications
tags.definition: Delegation of clinical research tasks and verification of staff qualifications, licensure, or supervision.

tags.name: Community Engagement & Participant Outreach
tags.definition: Community partnerships, engagement, public education, and research-participant outreach distinct from study recruitment.

tags.name: Conflict of Interest in Human Research
tags.definition: Conflict of interest affecting human subjects research, including IRB member, consultant, or study-related conflicts.

tags.name: Department of Defense (DoD) Research Requirements
tags.definition: Human subjects research requirements specific to Department of Defense support or oversight.

tags.name: Department of Education (ED) Research Requirements
tags.definition: Human subjects research requirements specific to U.S. Department of Education regulations.

tags.name: Department of Energy (DOE) Research Requirements
tags.definition: Human subjects research requirements specific to U.S. Department of Energy regulations.

tags.name: Department of Justice (DOJ) Research Requirements
tags.definition: Human subjects research requirements specific to Department of Justice support or oversight.

tags.name: Employee Conflict of Interest
tags.definition: University employee conflicts of interest, disclosures, and management outside or beyond research-specific requirements.

tags.name: Entrepreneurship & University Resources
tags.definition: Research-related entrepreneurship, external business activities, and authorized use of University resources.

tags.name: Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Research Requirements
tags.definition: Human subjects research requirements specific to Environmental Protection Agency regulations.

tags.name: Exempt Human Subjects Research Determinations
tags.definition: Procedures and criteria for determining whether human subjects research meets an exemption category.

tags.name: Export Controls & Sanctions
tags.definition: Restrictions, reviews, and authorizations involving controlled exports, transfers, foreign persons, or economic sanctions.

tags.name: FDA-Regulated Research
tags.definition: Human subjects research requirements applicable to FDA-regulated drugs, devices, or investigations.

tags.name: Financial Management & Reporting
tags.definition: Financial accounting, monitoring, reconciliation, and reporting for sponsored projects.

tags.name: Human Embryonic Stem Cell Research
tags.definition: Requirements governing research involving human embryonic stem cells.

tags.name: Human Research Program & IRB Oversight
tags.definition: Governance, authority, structure, and institutional oversight of the human research protection program and IRB.

tags.name: Human Trafficking Prevention & Reporting
tags.definition: Prohibitions, prevention responsibilities, and reporting requirements related to human trafficking in research activities.

tags.name: IACUC Oversight & Protocols
tags.definition: Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee authority, animal-use protocol review, approvals, and changes.

tags.name: IRB Determinations & Study Types
tags.definition: Determining whether activities require IRB consideration and how different research types are classified.

tags.name: IRB Review & Approval
tags.definition: IRB submission review, approval criteria, review pathways, modifications, continuing review, and review actions.

tags.name: Incident Reporting & Response
tags.definition: Reporting, reviewing, and responding to research incidents, including reportable safety events, data breaches, and other reportable occurrences.

tags.name: Individual Financial Conflict of Interest in Research
tags.definition: Financial interest disclosure, review, and management requirements for individuals involved in research.

tags.name: Institutional Conflict of Interest in Human Research
tags.definition: University-level or institutional financial conflicts that could affect human subjects research.

tags.name: International Research
tags.definition: Requirements substantively involving research abroad, international research activities, or cross-border collaborations.

tags.name: Investigational Drug Management
tags.definition: Investigator oversight, handling, storage, accountability, administration, or disposition of investigational drugs.

tags.name: Investigator Responsibilities
tags.definition: Substantive responsibilities of principal investigators or investigators for conduct, oversight, and compliance.

tags.name: Multisite Research & IRB Reliance
tags.definition: Coordination of multisite studies, IRB reliance arrangements, and allocation of review responsibilities among sites.

tags.name: Non-Exempt Human Subjects Research Review
tags.definition: Review pathways and requirements for non-exempt human subjects research, including expedited and convened IRB review.

tags.name: Not Human Subjects Research (NHSR) Determinations
tags.definition: Assessment and formal determination that an activity does not meet the regulatory definition of human subjects research.

tags.name: Participant Recruitment, Consent & Protections
tags.definition: Recruitment, informed consent, participant rights, and protections in human subjects research.

tags.name: Personnel Costs & Effort Reporting
tags.definition: Allocation, documentation, certification, or reporting of personnel time and costs on sponsored projects.

tags.name: Pharmaceutical Processes
tags.definition: Processes for requesting, handling, or administering pharmaceutical products in research settings.

tags.name: Post-Submission Activities
tags.definition: Administrative processes following proposal submission and before, or alongside, an award decision.

tags.name: Postdoctoral Appointments & Scholar Support
tags.definition: Postdoctoral appointments, status, conditions, and institutional support for postdoctoral scholars.

tags.name: Project Closeout
tags.definition: Sponsored-project closeout, required final reporting, reconciliation, and end-of-award responsibilities.

tags.name: Proposal Management
tags.definition: Preparing, reviewing, authorizing, submitting, and managing sponsored-project proposals.

tags.name: Quality Assurance
tags.definition: Quality assurance activities, checks, evaluation processes, and follow-up to improve compliance or quality.

tags.name: Research Core Management
tags.definition: Governance, administration, financial practices, and services of research core facilities or service centers.

tags.name: Research Data Ownership
tags.definition: Rights, ownership, authority, and institutional or investigator interests in research data and related materials.

tags.name: Research Data Stewardship
tags.definition: Responsible management, accuracy, integrity, maintenance, protection, and use of research data or research-related information.

tags.name: Research Data, Privacy & Specimens
tags.definition: Privacy, confidentiality, security, and authorized use of human research information or biological specimens.

tags.name: Research Finance
tags.definition: Financial requirements applicable to research, including accounting, payments, and use of research funds.

tags.name: Research Methods & Settings
tags.definition: Requirements associated with particular research methods, study designs, or research environments.

tags.name: Research Misconduct Reporting & Investigations
tags.definition: Reporting, reviewing, investigating, and responding to allegations of research misconduct.

tags.name: Research Participant Payments & Incentives
tags.definition: Compensation, reimbursement, incentives, and approved payments provided to research participants.

tags.name: Research Records Management & Retention
tags.definition: Creation, maintenance, preservation, access, retention, and disposition of required research or research oversight records.

tags.name: Research Security & Compliance Oversight
tags.definition: Research security program responsibilities, disclosures, risk management, monitoring, and compliance oversight.

tags.name: Research Security Training
tags.definition: Required research security training, completion timelines, renewal, and related training administration.

tags.name: Research Systems
tags.definition: Designated administrative systems, access, use, and processes supporting sponsored research management.

tags.name: Responsible Conduct of Research
tags.definition: Ethical and professional standards for responsible conduct, supervision, and integrity in research.

tags.name: Roles & Responsibilities
tags.definition: Substantive duties, decision-making authority, accountability, delegation, and allocation of responsibilities among research personnel, committees, institutional offices, or other parties.

tags.name: Special Research Populations & Participant Groups
tags.definition: Additional protections or requirements for particular groups of research participants.

tags.name: Sponsored Human Research
tags.definition: Human subjects research subject to sponsor agreements, contracts, or sponsor-specific obligations.

tags.name: Sponsored Programs Administration
tags.definition: Administrative processes, services, and responsibilities for sponsored programs.

tags.name: Sponsored Programs Oversight and Compliance
tags.definition: Institutional monitoring, accountability, and regulatory or sponsor compliance for sponsored programs.

tags.name: Sponsored Project Costs & Purchasing
tags.definition: Allowable costs, purchasing, procurement, and expense administration on sponsored projects.

tags.name: Training & Education
tags.definition: Requirements for research-related training, education, competency verification, qualifications, completion schedules, or ongoing learning. Apply only when training or competency is substantive.

tags.name: cGMP Compliance & Quality Agreements
tags.definition: Current good manufacturing practice quality oversight, quality agreements, and related authorization responsibilities.
